nativeRange: High mountains of Central and South Asia
biome: Cold alpine rock and sparse mountain scrub
facts: Snow leopards are solitary except when females are raising cubs.
Their thick tail can be nearly as long as the body and helps with balance and warmth.
Broad furred paws spread their weight on snow and grip steep rocky ground.
A smoky coat patterned with dark rosettes camouflages them on alpine slopes.
sources: Snow Leopard Trust fact sheet; San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance: Snow Leopard. Exhibit area, speed, ration and game price are transparent gameplay estimates.
